operations.title: Honest K5-to-K6 transport of the Entry-1063 canonical quotient line

operations.title: The canonical quadratic non-descent quotient line survives the honest K5-to-K6 enlargement
operations.statement: At ambient 19 over F_32003, the seven graph-zero relations have image rank 7 and adjoining the canonical quotient representative raises rank to 8. The quotient-line image therefore has rank 1. Its representative has 18 terms, all in normal block 0, with no block-2 support. This is finite-depth modular persistence, not characteristic-zero or direct-limit survival.
